prompt: Yellow calls the big parade downtown
title: Big Parade Downtown
irony: Yellow calls the parade like a race, so the marchers race and the parade falls apart until her slowest call brings them all together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Yellow lifts her megaphone on her porch as kids gather with drums for the big parade.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green counts slow march steps from his book while Navy hands out flags and Black smirks.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Yellow shouts And they are off, Black dares all to race, and the parade splits apart.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All chant the parade hook while racing fast out of step past the corner.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Outside Gold's Diner the racers tangle, drums drop, and Green's book pages fly.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Pink hands Black a giant flag, Silver trips, and the whole parade piles up laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant the hook again, still tangled in flags and stepping wrong.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Yellow sits quiet on her porch steps and owns that her fast calls spoiled the fun.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Green shows his slow-count page and Yellow decides to call the march slow.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All march slow together as Yellow sings the turned line about the slow parade.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: All sing the hook past Yellow's porch, marching slow together down the street.
